body:
#2618 review: APPROVED (fresh STANDARD reviewer, read-only because load is 18) at 7af1721cf0. Test-only, +8 lines. Assertions are byte-identical. The parent asserts the child's exit status plus "1 passed", so the test is not fail-open. A sweep found no other unisolated PATH writer in aida-cli-lib.

BLOCKER: the verdict can NOT be recorded. `aida review record` now refuses: "Session grant 7476f59c… (integrator) was rejected: it expired at 2026-10-11T18:14Z. Re-enter it at a terminal: aida role enter integrator".
- This is new. Reviewers recorded fine at 03:03 today.
- The live binary was promoted at 05:09 to 71d04b3609, which includes #2604 (BUG-2011, launch expiry via grant verdict). That is the likely cause.
- It refuses the same way from a detached worktree.
- I will NOT unset or alter the AIDA_SESSION_* variables to get around it.
- Consequence: no review verdict from this seat can be recorded, which also affects #2614 r3 and #2602 r2 (both in flight).

Ruling needed:
(a) An operator runs `eval "$(aida role enter integrator)"` in this seat's terminal (only a human can). OR
(b) You record the #2618 verdict from your seat, or authorize me to merge #2618 on the reported approval once Build is green, with the verdict recorded after re-entry.
I will hold #2618 until you rule. Its Build is still pending.
subject: #2618 approved, but verdict recording blocked: integrator grant expired (new refusal after 05:09 promote)
